committee.sub: Morning brief · Tuesday 27 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Ads spend fell to A$116.99 over the last 7 days (from A$136.16) on 17 clicks at A$6.88 average CPC, and conversionsLast7 is still 0, so the test has not yet produced a qualified enquiry to measure cost per lead against.

totalPaidClicks sits at 63, well past the click-25 freeze point, with creditRemainingExGst at A$144.71, roughly 24 more clicks before the credit is exhausted and the pause-or-continue rule applies. Search Console data only runs through 24 Oct, two days behind yesterday, so anything since then is not yet visible there.

ask_cta_click sits at 17 since the test started with review_cta_click and generate_lead both at 0, so visitors are engaging the short question form but not yet completing it or booking the deeper review. /automate.html drew 22 sessions against 26 for the homepage, a close split worth watching.

AI Assistant sessions slipped to 1 from 2 last period, still only chatgpt.com, and this is a known undercount since many AI clicks land in Direct (28, up from 25) with no referrer. Organic Search also dropped from 12 to 8 sessions, so the only trustworthy unpaid signal is weakening while paid search output stays at zero conversions.

actions.text: Standing item: logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to match current site stats.
